character: A huge man, about forty-five, brown hide greying at the muzzle, horns capped in old brass. A vine tattoo winding round one forearm. Calm, slow, patient eyes.
wardrobe: A sleeveless canvas sailor's jerkin, rope over one shoulder, a belaying pin in his belt.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing on a ship's deck, coiling a rope over his arm.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Herding sailors toward an open deck hatch, one huge arm outstretched, a pirate ship closing behind.
